correctness.rationale: Using the published projective characterization for \([n,3]\)-\(\mathrm{MDS}(3)\), every six-point ordinary-MDS configuration can be normalized by an ordered projective frame. The inspected verifier constructs each finite field of order below eleven, enumerates all normalized candidate pairs, checks all twenty collinearity determinants and all fifteen perfect-matching concurrence determinants, and exhausts exactly 1502 normalized pairs below eleven with no survivor. Over \(\mathbb F_{11}\) it checks the displayed witness and finds 72 good normalized pairs. The normalization is symmetry-complete, so this is an exhaustive finite proof rather than a sample.
residual_risks: The projective characterization is taken from the higher-order MDS literature rather than reproved from first principles.
